en.title: Build Hugging Face Spaces
en.description: Plan, build, and debug Gradio, Docker, or static apps on Spaces.
tasks: Plan, build, and debug Gradio, Docker, or static apps on Spaces.
prerequisites: hf CLI, a Hub account, app runtime, and access to the chosen hosting hardware.
en.example: Use huggingface-spaces. Inspect this Gradio app and propose a Space configuration with its dependencies and hosting needs.
en.expectedResult: A Space configuration, dependency list, and deployment/debugging steps.
limitations: Hosting eligibility, hardware availability, and charges must be checked before deployment.

zh.title: 构建 Hugging Face Spaces
zh.description: 规划、构建与调试 Spaces 上的 Gradio、Docker 或静态应用。
tasks: 规划、构建与调试 Spaces 上的 Gradio、Docker 或静态应用。
prerequisites: hf CLI、Hub 账号、应用运行环境，以及目标托管硬件权限。
zh.example: 请使用 huggingface-spaces：检查此 Gradio 应用，提出 Space 配置并列出依赖与托管需求。
zh.expectedResult: Space 配置、依赖清单及部署和调试步骤。
limitations: 部署前需核对托管资格、硬件可用性与费用。
